Frequently Asked Questions

What is the revenue of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month revenue of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. is ₹ 4,686.13 Cr, reflecting a 1-year growth of 12.00% and a 3-year CAGR of 16.12%. Annual and quarterly revenue trends are available in the Income Statement section.
What is the net profit of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month net profit (PAT) of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. is ₹ 225.04 Cr, with a 3-year earnings CAGR of 2.99%. Detailed profit history across annual and quarterly periods is in the Income Statement section.
What is the EBITDA of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month EBITDA of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. is approximately ₹ 287.28 Cr (based on an operating margin of 6.13%). EBITDA reflects core operating profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation.
What is the EPS of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month Earnings Per Share (EPS) of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. is 33.59. EPS trends across annual and quarterly periods are visible in the Income Statement section.
What is the debt level of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd.?
The debt-to-equity ratio of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. stands at 0.04. The interest coverage ratio is 5.22x, reflecting the company's ability to service debt from operating earnings. The full breakdown of total borrowings is in the Balance Sheet section.
What is the book value per share of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd.?
The estimated book value per share of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. is 307.35 (derived from a P/B ratio of 1.74 and market price of ₹ 533.55), reflecting the net asset value attributable to each share. See the Balance Sheet section for a full breakdown.
What is the cash flow from operations of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month operating cash flow of Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. is ₹ 323.30 Cr. Annual and quarterly cash flow data is available in the Cash Flow section of the Statements tab.
Does Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. report consolidated or standalone financials?
Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. reports consolidated financials. You can toggle between consolidated and standalone views using the switch at the top of each statement section.
